name: Asymmetric and Clustered VRP with Simultaneous Pickup and Deliveries benchmark
description: A collection of problem instances for evaluating vehicle routing algorithms on asymmetric, clustered VRP with simultaneous pickups and deliveries, variable costs, and forbidden paths.
reputation: A specialist benchmark used in the operations-research/vehicle-routing community for algorithm development and comparison, but not widely adopted outside that niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark consisting of classical VRP instances; solution quality depends on instance-specific best-known solutions and solver tuning. Comparisons require consistent solver/environment settings; varying instance sizes and constraints limit direct aggregate comparisons.
